title: Services
intro: Everything the event depends on: internet lines, DNS, the sites players need, the LAN cache, DHCP, firewalls, game servers and your own checks. Whether they answer, how full and how fast, checked from the event network by the local agent.
noLanCache: Floorbit reads no LAN cache log. Set LANCACHE_LOG to the cache's access log (and LANCACHE_CACHE_DIR for its disk).
viaAgent: The local agent sends the probes, from the event network.
noProbe: No probe host: no latency or loss.
name: Name
probeHelp: A server always reachable over the line; Floorbit connects to it for latency and loss.
lookupHelp: A name that must always resolve.
hostHelp: Floorbit connects to it a few times for the time it takes and the loss.
emptyAdmin: Nothing is watched yet. Add the internet lines, the resolvers players use, the sites they need and the game servers, or start with the usual sites.

setUpElsewhere.dhcp: From the DHCP server: set up in its plugin

panel.label: {{name}}: details
panel.tagsHelp: Your own groups, like a stage or a hall. Group the list by tag.
panel.fullIn_one: Full in about {{count}} minute at {{rate}} a minute
panel.fullIn_other: Full in about {{count}} minutes at {{rate}} a minute

check.fromHelp: Without a choice: where the device it checks is collected, else the primary agent. Another agent takes over while the one picked is away.
check.urlHelp: A URL. The agent opens it from the event network with a plain GET and keeps only the status and the time.
check.expectHelp: A code like 200, or a range like 200-399.
check.containsHelp: Down when this text is missing.
check.certWarn: Look when the certificate ends in (days)
check.hostHelp: A host name or an IP address, as the agent reaches it.
check.askHelp: UDP only answers a question it knows. With nothing, only a closed port counts as down.

asks.none: Nothing (only a closed port is down)

check.testHelp: Runs it once from the local agent, without saving.
